title: Montgomery County Police arrests

fields.name: district
fields.meaning: the police district where it happened (the county calls the field "District of occurrence")
notes: The districts are police districts. Montgomery County Police names six of them by their stations: district 1 is Rockville, district 2 is Bethesda, district 3 is Silver Spring, district 4 is Wheaton, district 5 is Germantown and district 6 is Montgomery Village.
Some records carry a district 8. It is not one of the six districts the county names, and the county's data does not say what it is.

fields.name: adjacent_to_school
fields.no: not within 500 feet of a school

fields.name: bureau
fields.note: No bureau is recorded for about 65 in every 100 records (28,620 of 43,884 on 2026-11-11). The codes are the county's own; their full names were not checked.

not_offered.division: 30 codes, 20,180 of 43,884 records empty, 14 codes with fewer than 100 records; left for a later approval

notes: These are Montgomery County, Maryland's own police records, published by the county. They are not statewide Maryland records.
